# Mr Krishna Boddu, Consultant Hip and Knee Surgeon, Ipswich

> Consultant orthopaedic surgeon (FRCS Tr & Orth, GMC 5206961) specialising in hip and knee replacement, partial and robotic-assisted (Mako) knee replacement, revision hip and knee replacement, and knee arthroscopy and meniscal surgery. Private clinic at Nuffield Health Ipswich Hospital, Foxhall Road, Ipswich IP4 5SW, for patients from Ipswich, Suffolk and north Essex. NHS consultant at Ipswich Hospital.

- Clinic: Monday, 8.30am to 12.30pm, at Nuffield Health Ipswich Hospital
- Secretary: Daniela Capaldo, 01473 279148, daniela.capaldo@nuffieldhealth.com
- Book online: https://www.nuffieldhealth.com/consultants/mr-krishna-boddu#book
- Self-pay fees: new consultation £200, follow-up £100. Surgery is a fixed, all-inclusive package from Nuffield Health Ipswich, given after the consultation. Nuffield guide prices (checked 14 November 2026): Hip replacement £18,503; Knee replacement £19,266; Partial (unicompartmental) knee replacement £17,882; Knee arthroscopy (keyhole surgery) £5,125.
- Insurance: recognised by Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva, Vitality, WPA, Allianz, Healix. Bupa fee-assured.
- Revision surgery: mostly at the Essex and Suffolk Elective Orthopaedic Centre, Colchester Hospital (private patient service); first consultation at Nuffield Health Ipswich.
- Experience: more than 1,000 hip and knee replacements; fellowships in primary and revision hip and knee replacement in Montreal and at King's College Hospital, London; joint replacements recorded on the National Joint Registry; 25 research publications.
- Reviews (as of November 2026): 4.96/5 from 124 reviews on Doctify, 5.0/5 from 32 on Top Doctors, 5.0/5 from 25 on Google.
- Profiles: Doctify https://www.doctify.com/uk/specialist/krishna-boddu ; Top Doctors https://www.topdoctors.co.uk/doctor/krishna-boddu/ ; PHIN https://phin.org.uk/profiles/consultants/mr-krishna-boddu--185866 ; National Joint Registry https://surgeonprofile.njrcentre.org.uk/SurgeonProfile?gmccode=5206961 ; Nuffield Health https://www.nuffieldhealth.com/consultants/mr-krishna-boddu ; Google https://maps.google.com/?cid=11382432351318201432

## Treatments

- [Hip replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/hip-replacement/): Replacing a hip worn by arthritis, to relieve pain and stiffness.
- [Revision hip replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/revision-hip-replacement/): Redo surgery for a hip replacement that is worn, loose or causing problems.
- [Knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/knee-replacement/): Total knee replacement for knee arthritis, including robotic-assisted surgery where suitable.
- [Partial knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/partial-knee-replacement/): Replacing only the worn part of the knee, keeping the healthy rest of the joint.
- [Revision knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/revision-knee-replacement/): Redo surgery for a knee replacement that is loose, unstable, infected or worn.
- [Knee arthroscopy and meniscal surgery](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/knee-arthroscopy-meniscal-surgery/): Keyhole surgery to repair or trim a torn meniscus when it is needed.
- [Robotic-assisted hip and knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/robotic-hip-and-knee-replacement/): Mako robotic-assisted hip, knee and partial knee replacement, used where clinically suitable.

## Conditions

- [Hip arthritis](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/hip-arthritis/): Groin, thigh or buttock pain, stiffness and a limp.
- [Knee arthritis](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/knee-arthritis/): Knee pain, stiffness and swelling from wear of the joint.
- [Meniscal tear](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/meniscal-tear/): Knee pain, catching or locking after a twist, or gradually with age.
- [Painful or worn joint replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/problem-joint-replacement/): Assessment of hip and knee replacements that are painful, unstable or wearing out.
- [Second opinions](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/second-opinion/): An independent view if you have been advised to have hip or knee surgery.

- [Private replacement costs](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/private-hip-and-knee-replacement-cost/): What you pay for, how fixed-price packages work, and using insurance.
- [Knee exercises before and after surgery](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/knee-replacement-exercises/): Simple exercises, with diagrams, to prepare for and recover from a knee replacement.
- [Hip pain or back pain?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/hip-pain-or-back-pain/): Where the pain is felt, and how to tell a hip problem from one coming from the back.
- [Am I too young for a replacement?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/am-i-too-young-for-a-joint-replacement/): Why there is no lower age limit, and how age affects the decision.
- [Steroid injections for arthritis](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/steroid-injections-for-hip-and-knee-arthritis/): How well they work, how long they last, the risks and the cost.
- [Life after a joint replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/life-after-a-joint-replacement/): Sport, kneeling, gardening, travel and looking after your new joint.
- [Why do joint replacements fail?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/why-do-joint-replacements-fail/): The common reasons a hip or knee replacement needs revising, and the warning signs.
- [Arthritis or a meniscal tear?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/knee-arthritis-or-meniscal-tear/): How to tell wear-and-tear arthritis from a torn cartilage, and why it matters.
- [Joint replacement if you are overweight](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/joint-replacement-if-overweight/): Why weight alone should not stop you being assessed, and how losing weight can help.
- [Pain relief after knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/pain-after-knee-replacement/): How painful it is, which painkillers help, how to cut them down, and when to seek advice.
- [Swelling after knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/swelling-after-knee-replacement/): How long swelling and warmth last, what helps, and when to seek advice.
- [Sleeping after a joint replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/sleeping-after-hip-or-knee-replacement/): Why sleep is often poor at first, comfortable positions, and tips that help.
- [Clicking or numbness after knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/clicking-or-numbness-after-knee-replacement/): Why a new knee can click, why the skin beside the scar can feel numb, and when to worry.
- [Blood clots after joint replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/blood-clots-after-joint-replacement/): The risk, how clots are prevented, and the warning signs.
- [Both knees at the same time](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/both-knees-replaced-at-the-same-time/): Why I usually advise replacing one knee at a time, even when both are worn.
- [Which approach for a hip replacement?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/anterior-or-posterior-approach-hip-replacement/): Anterior, posterior or anterolateral: why no approach is best, and the one I use.
- [Driving after a joint replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/driving-after-hip-or-knee-replacement/): When you can drive again after a hip or knee replacement, and how to know you are ready.
- [Work and flying after a joint replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/returning-to-work-and-flying-after-joint-replacement/): When most people go back to work, and when it is safe to fly, after a hip or knee replacement.
- [Kneeling and bending after a knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/kneeling-and-bending-after-knee-replacement/): Can you kneel after a knee replacement, how far will it bend, and what helps stiffness.
- [Hip replacement exercises](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/hip-replacement-exercises/): Simple exercises to do before and after a hip replacement, and how to progress them.
- [Wound care and showering](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/wound-care-and-showering-after-joint-replacement/): When you can shower, bath and swim after a hip or knee replacement, and how to look after your wound.
- [Hyaluronic acid and PRP injections](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/hyaluronic-acid-and-prp-injections-for-knee-arthritis/): What the best evidence shows about gel (hyaluronic acid), PRP and steroid injections for knee arthritis.
- [Pain on the outside of the hip](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/pain-on-the-outside-of-the-hip/): Outer hip pain is often not arthritis. What causes it, and the treatments that work best.
- [Which hip replacement implant?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/which-hip-replacement-implant/): Ceramic, metal, cemented or uncemented: how I choose the parts for your new hip.
- [Leg length and limp after a hip replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/leg-length-and-limp-after-hip-replacement/): Why your leg may feel longer, why you may limp at first, and what helps.
- [Do both of your hips need replacing?](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/both-hips-need-replacing/): Why I replace one hip at a time, and how long to wait before the second.
- [Preparing for your hip or knee replacement](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/preparing-for-hip-or-knee-replacement/): Pre-assessment, getting fit, and getting your home ready before surgery.
- [Recovery after knee arthroscopy and meniscal repair](https://www.mrboddu.co.uk/recovery-after-knee-arthroscopy-and-meniscal-repair/): What to expect after keyhole knee surgery: trimming compared with repair.
